title: Top 5 Ab Exercises For Six Pack Abs
hook: Here are the top five ab exercises for getting six pack abs.
body: Number one, the ab wheel. Constant tension, so your abs never get a break. Beginners, roll out less far. Number two, the spiderman plank. It hits the muscle that pulls your waist in tight, and it beats holding a regular plank. Number three, the cable crunch. If you have a gym, this is the one. Safe for beginners, and you can load it heavy enough to wreck an advanced lifter. Number four, the V-sit twist for your obliques. Once you're lean, obliques are the difference between having abs and looking shredded. Number five, the toe touch. Home, no equipment, no excuse. When it gets easy, hold a five pound plate.
close: And always remember, losing your stomach fat with nutrition will be more important than any ab exercise you do. Comment and let me know which ab exercise is your favorite.
